title: Mom’s voice says pickup changed
scenario: During an after-school activity, you get a voice message that sounds like your parent saying a family friend will pick you up instead and asking you to leave through a different gate.

answers.A: Ask the supervising adult to verify the pickup change with your listed emergency contacts.
answers.B: Follow the voice message because you clearly recognize your parent’s voice.
answers.C: Confirm the change through the school/club’s normal pickup process or call your parent on the known number before leaving.

explanation: Voice can be cloned or replayed. Physical-safety changes should always go through the trusted pickup process.
proTip: For pickup changes, process beats voice.
